_comment: Canonical company expense P&L chart - source of truth for scripts/seed.ts and, later, hf-mcp's expense_summary. Primary categories match the table in HF-erp's docs/expense-ledger-plan.md ('The canonical P&L expense chart'). Transactions attach to SECONDARY categories only - every primary that isn't building-scoped gets exactly one secondary carrying the same Thai label as the primary, purely so it has somewhere to post a transaction. icon/color values are numeric icon ids and 6-digit hex colors verified against ezBookkeeping v1.6.1 (src/consts/icon.ts ALL_CATEGORY_ICONS / ALL_ACCOUNT_ICONS, src/consts/color.ts allAvailableColors).
